Great question — using it consistently and correctly makes a big difference.
Simple daily routine:
Put a bit of moisture on your left tragus
Clip the earpiece on (cable goes over/behind your ear)
Turn it on and slowly increase until you feel a light, pleasant tingling
Keep it at that level during the session
How long to use it:
30–60 minutes per day
Best: morning, or split into morning + evening before sleep
During the session:
You can read, work, meditate, or relax while using it
If the sensation fades or gets stronger, adjust the level slightly
Key tip:
The right level = light tingling, no pain
Higher intensity doesn’t mean better results
